source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-7

procedures.title: Hydraulic brake tubing: double-lap flaring
steps: Finish the flare: insert the pointed finish flare punch and the ram, then tap the ram until a good seat forms (see figure 14 in the manual).
notes: Check the seat now and then while finishing so it is not over-seated.

procedures.title: Parking brake: adjust
notes: The rear brakes serve as both the hydraulic service brake and the mechanical parking brake (continues on the next page).
The service-brake (drum) preliminary adjustment on this page applies to drum-brake models only and is not included; the Corvette uses four-wheel disc brakes.
